description: This file provides declarations and documentation for list processing functions used in the FreeType project, including list management, node operations, and iteration mechanisms.

methods.name: FT_List_Find
methods.description: Finds the list node for a given object in a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Add
methods.description: Appends a node to the end of a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node at the head of a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from a list without checking if it belongs to the list.

methods.name: FT_List_Up
methods.description: Moves a node to the head of the list, used for LRU management.

methods.name: FT_List_Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over list nodes, calling a user-defined function.

methods.name: FT_List_Finalize
methods.description: Destroys all list elements and the list itself, applying a destructor to each element.
